historical_record.description: An earlier conditional-use application for an automobile dismantling yard on the site was heard and disapproved by the City Planning Commission in April 1970.

The open lot, leased from the State, was used along its Evans Avenue frontage as a used-car sales lot, with ten-foot fences and some shrubbery. The City Planning Commission approved, with conditions, an open-lot automobile dismantling yard with used-parts sales behind the used-car lot, entered from Napoleon Street.
